The Doobie Brothers – One Step Closer

Original 1980 Warner Bros. Records pressing of One Step Closer, the final Doobie Brothers studio album before their initial breakup. Featuring the hit title track and the soulful single "Real Love," this album is a great addition for fans of classic rock, blue-eyed soul, and yacht rock.

Album Details

  • Artist: The Doobie Brothers
  • Title: One Step Closer
  • Label: Warner Bros. Records
  • Catalog Number: HS 3452
  • Format: 12" LP
  • Speed: 33⅓ RPM
  • Stereo
  • Released: 1980
  • Made in U.S.A.

Track Listing

Side One

  • Dedicate This Heart
  • Real Love
  • No Stoppin' Us Now
  • Thank You Love

Side Two

  • One Step Closer
  • Keep This Train A-Rollin'
  • Just in Time
  • South Bay Strut
  • One by One
